Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join activities to assays on assay_id, filter by assay CHEMBL1614455. Join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno. Filter to exact measurements: standard_relation '=' and standard_value not null. Return all matching rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
